name: fl_wizard_scaffold
description: Interactive Human-in-the-Loop Bash Wizard generator. Scaffolds self-contained, frozen-core terminal wizards for human-only operations (OAuth setup, cloud secrets, interactive environment provisioning) with silent input, .env upsert, and GitHub secret injection.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'scaffold' (default, generates bash wizard script) or 'validate_script'.

wizard_title.description: Display title and header for the interactive setup wizard.

output_path.description: Output path where the generated wizard script will be saved. Defaults to './setup_wizard.sh'.

stages_json.description: JSON array of stage definitions: [ { name, description, steps: [ { type: 'ask'|'ask_secret'|'open_url'|'confirm', var_name, prompt, url } ] } ].

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
